description: Multirotor domain pack: flight-controller configuration (Betaflight) generated from the UHD model.

skills.summary: Derive a flight-controller configuration from UHD links and part facts, every line cited, every setting checked against pinned firmware sources
Bench-verify a generated FC configuration on hardware (props off) and record the result as measured test data

operations.summary: Generate a Betaflight CLI dump (serial ports, receiver, OSD/VTX, GPS, compass) from the model's links; every line cites its link or part fact
Manufacturing Package: the flight-controller configuration (file and loading steps) in the root unit's work order; refuses a configuration that no longer matches the model
Manufacturing Package: the props-off bench check of the flight controller in the root unit's test plan
